author: TheMalignity
body:
Stack xp bonuses and go on a boss hunt, maybe leave your party since xp will be split. Absolutely get the quest BoG if you havent already. Unless you have a statue buff and xp potion and you’re doing a special hard horde gauntlet I dont think they’re that great for xp. But if you get all the buffs and a good gauntlet they can be really good. Another thing is to wait for your kingdom to get an xp temple and find a statue and just DEMOLISH your supply of monster remains. None of these things is going to skyrocket your xp gains but deliberate play should get you there. 
ALSO: maybe your raiding equipment is bad? If your raiding is slow xp grinding will be difficult.

author: NSA_Chatbot
body:
I'm in the same boat, let's take a look.  If we're both at 218, we're at 76,809,706,174 XP, and 225 is 118,090,889,217, difference of 41.3 Billion XP.  

Summoned raid is about 500M per, depending on what you get; that's 82 solo raids, closer to 120 Kingdom raids.  I don't know about you, but I'm out of Summoning Scrolls and the RNG has given me none over the last month of gauntlets.  (I have a mostly-dead Phoenix and a 2nd Horseman.) 

26 days left, that means either: 

**3 Summoned raids a day,** or 

**5 Kingdom raids per day.**  

Note that themed gauntlets will phase in and out, the one near me turned back into a "plain" dungeon.  There are tons in the city that are different (the players downtown have a massive advantage) 

Realistically we'll want it done with several days to spare so we can find it in a bestiary.

author: [deleted]
body: What kind of gauntlets? If you haven't tried them already, Hard Mode gauntlets could be a way to increase your progress.

author: [deleted]
body:
Best thing I found was to spam arthus if your kingdom allows for it.... polly isn't worth it honestly, you're probably doing around 30k per attack and it's taking probably 2 to 3 runs per polly. Arthus should be a 1 run boss. Find some underworld and chaos portals and hope for the best.... spam those world raids. 

Kingdom exp bonus plus exp shrine and overwolrd boss spam is hard to beat...  

Another option, which some might find cheating is getting somebody that's t10 but within 25 levels of you to be in your party and kill stuff in overworld and dungeons. I'm currently in that boat with a buddy of mine who I'm trying to get to 225..... I just hit 231 and there's a berserk gilgamesh down the street, 1.3 billion party exp, iirc we each get like 60% of that.

author: Hatefly
body:
I just recently did this. Took about 3 days. Best bet is to summon and solo a bunch of world raid events.   
  
Not sure if it works or helps, but I got each one down to a few k health, ran then came back with a Venin or Questing Staff and two Band of Gods equipped to finish them off.   
  
Each level took like 15 to 20 scrolls if that helps.
